items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Oh, definitely. I had worked the Town and Country with Tony, and I don't know how many times I worked the Copa.

ctx.x: Oh, definitely. I had worked the Town and Country with Tony, and I don't know how many times I worked the Copa. So Tony told his contractor, he said, "Call Quent to come on down here to the Waldorf." He said, "We know his condition, but I just want him here," you know.

And he called me and I went down to the Waldorf and I sat there -- it was kind of rough at first -- but -- Wayne Andre was there. I think Freddie Zito was there, and Bill, he just came in town to do that show.
